verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that a Devin API exists for integrating Devin into applications and automating workflows, and that it can create sessions on behalf of organization users. However, no cited item says how the API authenticates. Nothing documents API keys, tokens, or service credentials as an alternative to account login, so the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login
